reviews.text: I find that amuse’s other tints tend to make my lips feel dry, but the dew tint doesn’t have that same problem. It’s very comfortable on the lips and stains really well. I also really like the pointed applicator.
reviews.zh: 我發現 amuse 嘅其他 tint 都會令到我嘴唇覺得乾，但 Dew Tint 就冇呢個問題。搽上嘴好舒服，而且染色效果好好。我亦都好鍾意佢個尖頭嘅 applicator。

reviews.text: Bought it in a super sale set that came with the cushion and the mini powder tint as well. The colour is a nice cool tone pink and leaves quite a dark tint. It also smells really nice. It feels hydrating on my lips and doesn't settle into my lip lines. After a while, it forms this sort of film and no colour gets transferred.
reviews.zh: 喺大減價套裝買嘅，附送 cushion 同迷你 powder tint。顏色係幾靚嘅冷調粉紅，染出嚟嘅色好深。味道亦都好香。搽上嘴好保濕，而且唔會卡入唇紋。過一陣會形成一層薄膜，唔會甩色。

reviews.text:
Wow — this is one of the best lip tints I’ve ever tried!
The shades are absolutely beautiful, with the perfect level of pigment — not too strong, but definitely visible.
I was especially impressed with the lighter shades — unlike many other brands, they actually show up on the lips!

The packaging is pretty cute, but I personally didn’t love it. It has a bit of a childish vibe that makes it look like a toy or a kids’ product, which doesn’t really reflect the quality of what’s inside.
But honestly — who cares? What really matters is the formula, and this one is amazing!
reviews.zh:
哇——呢個係我用過最好嘅唇釉之一！
色號靚到不得了，顯色程度剛剛好——唔會太濃，但一定睇得見。
我尤其對淺色號印象深刻——同好多其他品牌唔同，佢哋真係搽上嘴見到色！

包裝幾得意，但我自己就唔係好鍾意。望落有少少幼稚，似玩具或者細路仔嘅產品，同內裏嘅質素唔太匹配。
但老實講——邊個在乎呢？最重要係配方，呢個真係勁！

reviews.text: This tint is watery upon application, and as it sets, it becomes slightly thicker. The color deepens after a few seconds, and a medium gloss and tint forms if you leave it alone to set. It doesn't last through meals but is very long-lasting otherwise. There's a little bit of transfer throughout the day. 13 is a medium neutral pink.
reviews.zh: 呢隻 tint 一上嘴好水狀，但等佢 set 完就會變得稍微稠少少。幾秒之後顏色會加深，放埋一邊等佢 set 就會形成中等光澤同 tint。食嘢會甩，但除此之外好持久。成日入面都會有少少甩色。13 號係中等嘅中性粉紅。

reviews.text: My favorite thing about this is the smell! It smells like sweet, fresh apple juice. Really pretty color, but after wearing it for a while it starts to read more pink than expected on my skin tone. Also, I found it to be a little drying as time went by, so I wear it over a lip balm, but the pigmentation and longevity is still good even if I do this! The glossy finish is really nice and the stain is so pretty, one swipe is all I need for my lips.
reviews.zh: 我最鍾意嘅係佢嘅味道！聞落好似甜嘅、新鮮蘋果汁。顏色真係好靚，但戴耐咗之後喺我膚色上面睇落比預期中更加偏粉紅。而且，戴耐咗我覺得有少少乾，所以我會搽層潤唇膏先再用，但即使係咁，顯色度同持久度都仲係好好！光澤感嘅妝效真係好靚，個染色亦都好靚，掃一下就夠上色。

reviews.text: Love the way it tints my lips. Even after eating the color is still nicely there because of the tint. Lips look dewy and shiny but not sticky. Colors were a bit different than the pictures online. It was a bit darker in person than on the online site pictures. But still ended up liked the colors.
reviews.zh: 好鍾意佢染上我嘴唇嘅效果。就算食完嘢，顏色都仲喺度，因為有 tint 嘅關係。嘴唇望落水潤有光澤但唔會黐立立。顏色同網上嘅相有少少唔同。實物比網站嘅相深色少少。但最後都仲係鍾意呢個顏色。

reviews.text:
Unlike what the name would suggest, Dew Boksoongah is more mauve/rose than peach. It looks like a really creamy rose pink on my palms but it’s definitely deeper, more mauve-y pink on my lips, even after covering my lips with concealer. But, like everyone knows, color payoff really does depend a lot on a person’s natural lip color.

Pros: 
- Blurs out lip wrinkles, makes lips look really bouncy? and juicy which I love ♡
- As long as you don’t eat, the tint stains very evenly and won’t leave your lips blotchy. 
- Applicator doles out perfect amount of product. (scrape along inner neck when removing)

Cons: 
- Gets deeper and darker the more you apply, which I don’t like. Left me looking like I had wine mouth by the 3rd or 4th application :\ which I don’t like because I look best with brighter, lighter colors. 
- Could just be me but the container is a lot smaller+less product than I expected.

* Stickiness remains once tint fades but that's expected and doesn't bother me much.
reviews.zh:
同個名俾你嘅印象唔同，Dew Boksoongah 比較似紫紅／玫瑰色多過桃色。喺我掌心望落係好奶潤嘅玫瑰粉紅，但上嘴就明顯深色啲，係比較紫紅嘅粉紅，就算用 concealer 蓋住原本唇色都係咁。不過，大家都知道，顯色度好大程度睇個人原本嘅唇色。

優點：
- 修飾唇紋，令到嘴唇望落好彈？同 juicy，我好鍾意 ♡
- 只要唔食嘢，個 tint 染得好均勻，唔會一撻撻。
- 個 applicator 拎嘅量剛剛好。（拎出嚟時刮住內頸位）

缺點：
- 塗得越多層就越深色，我唔鍾意。到第 3、4 層嘅時候望落好似飲完紅酒咁 :\ 我唔鍾意因為我着淺啲、亮啲嘅色望落最靚。
- 可能得我係咁覺，但個容器比我預期細好多＋份量少好多。

* tint 退咗之後仲有少少黐立立，但呢個係預期之內，唔會太困擾我。

reviews.text: Very liquidy and definitely dewy, like its name suggests. I got it in #13 and it's a very pretty rosy nude color. Very comfortable to wear, not sticky at all. It even leaves behind a little stain, which I love.
reviews.zh: 好水狀，而且真係如其名咁水潤。我買咗 #13，係好靚嘅玫瑰裸色。戴住好舒服，完全唔黐立立。仲留到少少染色，我好鍾意。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
